messages.author: 5893d17d64b5b0c2
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Re: Why do I have to confirm deployment?
parts:
The Publish button in RStudio always uses deployApp. It doesn't use deployDoc at all; deployDoc is just a convenient wrapper for deployApp for use at the R console that automates the process finding a document's dependencies.

When publishing content, the Publish button first figures out a list of files to publish; for a Shiny app this is the entire directory less some files known to be unnecessary; for documents it invokes rmarkdown::find_external_resources to discover the .Rmd's dependencies. The user has the opportunity to change the list of files to be deployed; once the user's selections are made, it calls deployApp with the final list of files.

Does that help? If it doesn't, let me know what particular part of the publish process you're interested in and I can elaborate further, or point you to the relevant part of the IDE code (which does mostly live in R for this feature). 

Jonathan.
